Maya Chen: Hey — quick question about tomorrow's orientation. The calendar invite shows 9:00 PT but I'm in CET and that maps to 18:00 for me. Did we switch times or is there a repeat session for EMEA? Also the ICS I downloaded didn't include the Zoom passcode.
Kevin Patel: Seeing the same. I'm GMT and it's 17:00 for me. If there's only one session that's a bit late for EMEA folks.
Ashley R.: I'm on APAC — the main time is pretty early here (3am). Any chance we have a recording/video posted quickly after? :sleepy:
DevEx Kelly: Sorry for the confusion, team — invite was originally created in PT zone. We pushed two updates:
1) Added a second live repeat for EMEA (08:00 UTC / 09:00 CET) — new invite sent to everyone who RSVP'd.
2) Updated the ICS files so they include the Zoom join/passcode and proper TZ tags.
Links below.

DevEx Kelly: Zoom (PT session): https://redwood.zoom.us/j/1234567890?pwd=pt-session-pass
Passcode: 4Redwood!

DevEx Kelly: Zoom (EMEA repeat): https://redwood.zoom.us/j/0987654321?pwd=emea-repeat
Passcode: EMEA2026

DevEx Kelly: If your calendar client still shows the old time, try re-downloading the updated ICS from the invite or use this fallback iCal link:
```
https://calendar.redwood.com/ical/onboarding-2026.ics
```
On recording: we'll upload the recording to the onboarding drive within 1 hour after each live session and post the link here.

Jon S.: I tried the new ICS on Outlook and it kept creating a duplicate event at the old time. Any tips for Outlook folks?

DevEx Kelly: Outlook workaround:
1) Delete the old event from your calendar first.
2) Right-click the ICS link and "Save As" to disk.
3) In Outlook: File > Open & Export > Import/Export > "Import an iCalendar (.ics) or vCalendar file" > choose the saved file.
That usually forces the correct TZ mapping. If it still shows weird, ping me and I can add you to the EMEA invite manually.

Maya Chen: Awesome, thanks Kelly — appreciate the quick fix. Will join the EMEA repeat.
